approved_runtime_evidence_not_sufficient.decision: Approved runtime principal lifecycle evidence would be necessary evidence, but it is not sufficient to publish obelisk.player_identity.v1.
why: runtime evidence can prove a candidate lifecycle route was observed; it does not define a stable C ABI
runtime evidence can show login/logout ordering; it does not choose the copied opaque identifier form, generation rules, or scope flags
runtime evidence can support internal lifecycle semantics; it does not prove owner-token registration, unregister, plugin unload cleanup, or in-flight callback drain
runtime evidence does not provide ABI layout tests, SDK consumer tests, or append-only compatibility rules
runtime evidence does not prove process-local scope, cross-instance isolation, or cluster identity semantics
runtime evidence does not authorize permissions/admin, command/chat response, player lookup, persistence, mutation, return override, or cross-process identity claims

contract_gate_inputs.non_claim: Accepted runtime lifecycle evidence is a contract-review input only; it does not resolve public identity promotion by itself.

Identifier-redaction evidence is sanitized contract-review input only; the privacy blocker remains unresolved until the public identifier form, redaction policy, logging policy, and persistence prohibition are reviewed.
Candidate invalidation-policy acceptance is review input only; the full lifetime/generation/scope blocker remains unresolved.

Private POD layout and public ABI preflight candidates are offline review inputs only; they do not add public symbols, capability bits, callbacks, ABI layout guarantees, SDK consumer readiness, or promotion readiness.
Owner-token SDK consumer contract evidence is candidate-only review input; it does not resolve owner cleanup or expose a public callback ABI.
Identity promotion cannot unlock permissions/admin, command response, commands/replies, lookup, persistence, mutation, or return override; those surfaces remain separate blocked contracts.
